purpose: Concrete investigation policy for human review; not an executable scientific scenario

scope.global_direction: Reuse tested kernels through local adapters, units, climate, transport and service configuration; measure transfer separately

proposed_decisions.assignment_rationale: The PRD identifies nearest travel time as the default. The comparison first maximizes served tonnes and then minimizes tonne-minutes. Do not select an arm after seeing favorable ranks.
proposed_decisions.threshold_rationale: A proposed decision convention for most draws; no empirical calibration or reliability claim.
proposed_decisions.case_weights: equal for each declared case; shared parameter draws across cases
proposed_decisions.ablation_rule: Use the PRD rule: at least two top-ten replacements and no worse predefined hindcast/verification evidence; missing comparison means no retention claim.
proposed_decisions.ablation_membership_metric: replacement_count_min_of_removed_and_added; report removals/additions separately so a shrinking shortlist is not called replacement
proposed_decisions.new_region_entry: document adapters, units, suitable analysis CRS, local source coverage, local parameter evidence and a prospective untouched transfer protocol
